name: Boiler Room / Heating System Sign
hierarchyPath: Building Signs > HPD Signs > Boiler Room / Heating System Sign
description: An owner is required to display the name and location of the individual possessing the boiler room key on notices approved by HPD, designated as HPD heating system signs. One notice should be prominently placed in the lobby, and another on the boiler room’s entrance door, as mandated by HMC § 27-2033.
